uzo.purpose: Turns a setting on or off and applies it at once: notifications, dark mode, a feature.

instead.kialo: A setting that applies only when the form is sent is a checkbox, because a switch promises that the change is already done; Fundamento covers it with markobutono.

boundary.kialo: A switch holds on or off, because its track has two ends; a third, mixed state has no place the knob could stand.
A switch without a visible label says that something is on, not what, because the track shows the state and only the label names the setting.

containers.name: settings-list
containers.kialo: Settings stand one below the other, each switch with its label, because a person scans the list for the setting and reads its state beside it.

containers.name: dialog
containers.kialo: A dialog may offer a setting that applies at once, because the change is seen while the dialog is open.

with.kialo: A settings form holds fields and switches together, because some settings take a value and some are only on or off; the switch applies at once, the field with the form.
A switch inside a dialog applies at once like everywhere, because the dialog only frames the setting.

never.kialo: A switch stands in no slot of a button, because a button is one target with one name and the switch could not be reached on its own.

case.de: Die Einstellung gilt erst, wenn das Formular gesendet wird.
case.en: The setting applies only when the form is sent.

case.de: Etwas soll einmal geschehen, statt an oder aus zu bleiben.
case.en: Something is to happen once, instead of staying on or off.

case.de: Es gibt mehr als zwei Zustände zur Wahl.
case.en: There are more than two states to choose from.

do.de: Lass die Beschriftung die Einstellung nennen, nicht ihren Zustand.
do.en: Let the label name the setting, not its state.

do.de: Wende die Änderung sofort an und setze loading, solange sie gespeichert wird.
do.en: Apply the change at once and set loading while it is saved.

do.de: Nimm label-side start für eine Liste von Einstellungen mit den Schaltern in einer Spalte am Ende.
do.en: Use label-side start for a list of settings with the switches in one column at the end.

dont.de: Einen dritten, gemischten Zustand zeigen wollen.
dont.en: Want to show a third, mixed state.

dont.de: Die Größe large neu setzen: Sie ist ein veralteter Name für medium und wird als medium gezeigt.
dont.en: Set the size large anew: it is a deprecated name for medium and is shown as medium.

dont.de: Einen Schalter ohne sichtbare Beschriftung zeigen.
dont.en: Show a switch without a visible label.

action.de: Schaltet die Einstellung an oder aus, und sie gilt sofort.
action.en: Turns the setting on or off, and it applies at once.
